avoid_supplements.name: Potassium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Clavulanate may cause hyperkalemia; combined potassium supplementation increases risk of dangerous serum levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor potassium levels if supplementation is essential

avoid_supplements.name: Methotrexate
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Amoxicillin-clavulanate may reduce renal clearance of methotrexate, increasing toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; use alternative antibiotic if possible or monitor methotrexate levels closely

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Antibiotic may reduce effectiveness of probiotic colonization; timing separation may improve efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Take probiotics at least 2-3 hours apart from antibiotic dose

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin K supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Prolonged antibiotic use may deplete vitamin K-producing gut flora
caution_supplements.action: Consider vitamin K supplementation if antibiotic course exceeds 2 weeks

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (taken concurrently)
avoid_foods.mechanism: May delay and reduce absorption of amoxicillin-clavulanate, particularly clavulanate component
avoid_foods.action: Take on empty stomach (1 hour before or 2 hours after meals) for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Dairy products
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly reduce amoxicillin absorption due to calcium and protein binding
caution_foods.action: Separate dairy intake by 2+ hours from antibiotic doses when possible

caution_foods.name: Acidic foods/beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May affect gastric pH and antibiotic absorption, though effect is minimal
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance needed; maintain consistent timing relative to meals

monitoring_notes: Monitor for gastrointestinal effects, allergic reactions, and hepatic function (clavulanate can cause liver injury). In patients with renal impairment or those on prolonged therapy, assess potassium levels and vitamin K status.
